summary.en: The account holds population genetics and harvested renewal as laws in counts, by its own verdict restated and adding no new population-genetic prediction; what the fields state with quantities (rates, folds over the reals, relaxation times, measured r, b, c) it mostly does not state. Where an entry agrees with a checked law, the law is a form in counts under premises, mostly crediting the field itself: a threshold stands in a premise, evolutionary suicide has its pattern only, the major transitions themselves are listed as not shown, and no law of hysteresis stands. Extinction debt, evolutionary traps and Fisher's loop are readings proposed here, not stated. The theses go further and stand mixed: T1's need passed on one yeast experiment's regimes, held out from the fit and not the analyst, while on values not read before no frozen test of it has passed and no field test of a need measured in advance has run; T2 narrowed after failing in the flour beetle; three seabird tests did not reject T6, EW2 at low power, EW4 at moderate. Three of the plan's seeds did not hold as written: Allee's critical mass, suicide's witness, runaway as closed capture. Divergences are kept: Red Queen, runaway's cost, debt against T1, stage structure against T2's former wording, a full taker ending with the rest, persistence through patch turnover, the maximand, Gaia.

source.work: May, Thresholds and breakpoints in ecosystems with a multiplicity of stable states (1977); Scheffer et al., Catastrophic shifts in ecosystems (2001)
source.locator: locator unverified; the papers' central argument

sense.en: Under the same external conditions a community can hold more than one self-maintaining state, each with its basin. Slowly moving a parameter past a fold brings a sudden shift, and return needs the parameter moved well back. Shallow lakes, clear or turbid, are the stock case. How often real systems do this is disputed (Schröder, Persson and De Roos 2005, as I recall).

reading.en: Proved in counts: under one draw a level splits exactly at a point, the lower fate ending where nothing gives from nothing. With adjusting giving every run rests in one of two basins, the record's word: at the draw, or below it with level and recent giving equal, positive where something is given from nothing. A witness under inhibition holds from two and nothing and ends from two and two; by symmetry each of two can hold alone. Shares lock either side of a critical mass. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem, whole numbers, under stated premises: a level up to a top ends exactly where it starts below H + y. Credited at 08 as harvesting under depensation and the fold (Clark 1976; May 1977), in whole numbers. The record's limits: the fold over the reals and the other order of a step are not stated.

Theorem: for giving rising in both and keeping a band, runs resting below the draw are those from levels below a least level, which does not rise with the recent giving. Its correspondence: 'the basins are resting below the draw and resting at the regime's point', beside Hirsch and Smith 2005. Witness Notch: without rising giving no least level separates the runs.

Theorem: every run of an adjustment of giving rising with what is left and with the recent giving, within a band up to hi, comes to rest within 3 hi + 3 steps, at the regime's point or below the draw. Witness Adjusted.rests_short: a rest below the draw where something is given from nothing. Over the reals a run converges and need not rest.

Theorem (any type): under any determined law, courses meeting is an equivalence whose classes are basins; within finitely many configurations each basin holds one cycle. Not shown: how many basins an actual law has. Its neighbour attraction-is-not-returning says lock-in here is 'not an attractor in the classical sense'.

Theorem: under mutual support thresholds are exact and do not rise as any level or recent giving rises; what was given can lower a threshold (witness Momentum). Its correspondence names history-dependent response as hysteresis.

Theorem: under mutual support the order of states is kept and ending is down-closed; beyond a band support can sustain a cycle. Witness MutualInhibition: each gives only where nothing is left of the other; the first ends from two and two yet holds from two and nothing. 'no down-closure without mutual support, and the threshold rises with the partner'.
Theorem (counts): with lo <= hi a share decides exactly where lo < c < hi, and every such course is locked one way. It reads shares of carriers under a rule, not levels of a community.
On yeast: MQ2 passed 4 of 8, the need and its rise with the draw, levels failing; MQ6 3 of 10, neither break timed. In 113 fish stocks MQ3 passed 0 of 4.

account_adds.en: Proved in counts, for any giving law meeting the premises: the point's exactness, a witness that rising giving is needed, a joint draw's rise superadditive up to one. These locate an end and order nothing. The plane law's wording admits two positive rests under one law; the one witness of a positive lower rest I read has no upper rest. 02 keeps the words apart: 'a region ceasing, a state's departure and a strict bifurcation are not one "phase transition"'.

source_adds.en: The loop: a parameter moved past a fold and back, return at a different value, the loop's width. No law of that path stands here (the dynamics row's hysteresis entry). Over the reals the fold as a bifurcation in a moving parameter (the margin record: 'The fold over the reals... neither is stated'), noise-driven shifts between states, which here stand only for shares, and measured lake and reef cases with their dispute. 'Hysteresis' appears only as a correspondence word in two records, 'bistable' in S-16's credit and one market record.

name.en: Recovery needs more than removing the pressure

source.work: Scheffer et al., Catastrophic shifts in ecosystems (2001); Hutchings, Collapse and recovery of marine fishes (2000)

sense.en: Having collapsed, a system may stay low after the driver is relaxed. Lakes can stay turbid after loading falls; many collapsed fish stocks recovered little after catches fell, as I recall Hutchings. The field offers several explanations, not only a threshold: changed ecosystems, continued catch, altered life history.

reading.en: Proved: with balance, where the joint exchange gives no more than it takes below m, a level below m never returns to it, gated renewal being the case. T1 turns this into one forbidden form: a condition below a need measured in advance returning with nothing given from beyond. Return from outside stays allowed, and the need is measured apart from the fate. Past the model it is conjectured; its one field design on return was refused at the table's header. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (World): with balance, where the joint exchange gives no more than it takes below m, a level below m never returns to it, gated renewal being the case.

T1 forbids 'a condition below a need measured in advance returning with nothing given from beyond'. No field test of a need measured in advance has run; T1R, on whether the lakes' natural renewal returns once stocking has raised adults above that need, is frozen and was refused; neither says anything of T1.

Theorem: with an ending made final as a separate premise, support returning after the reserve is spent finds no dependent; 'exhaustion alone does not give it'. A reserve spanning the gap bridges it. Not shown: that ending is final for actual dependents. Correspondence: a collapse that support's return does not undo, one-sided only: hysteresis's distinct collapse and recovery thresholds are not stated.

At the step the excess reaches the end holds for any renewal, and a formation renewed from outside can be active again (Restored.returns); the gated conclusions after that step are proved only for renewal depending on what it renews.

Theorem: a dependence renewed by r at its need and at most r below is lost exactly where the draw exceeds r, for good. 'Gated, a level below the need stays below whatever is drawn.' Credits Clark 1976 on critical depensation. The renewal at or above the need is exactly r there: no logistic growth.

On shares, not renewal: a reading leaves the lock only before the first step at which the others' late reading would favour the shapers. 'Biggs, Carpenter and Brock (2009) give the continuous analogue of the window.'

account_adds.en: Separates what returns: from outside or not, and at which grain. Stocks showing no need above the least that can renew are not reached by T1's forbidden return, and their showing none does not count against T1. For shares the matter is a window, not renewal: a lock can be left only before a step, whose continuous analogue 02 credits to Biggs, Carpenter and Brock (2009).

source_adds.en: The field's other explanations (changed ecosystems, continued catch, altered life history) and measured recovery rates; and non-recovery where no need has been measured at all, on which T1 is silent.

source.work: Stephens, Sutherland and Freckleton, What is the Allee effect? (1999); Courchamp, Berec and Gascoigne, Allee Effects in Ecology and Conservation (2008)
source.locator: definitions of component, demographic, strong and weak effects

sense.en: A component of fitness rises with density (component effect); per-capita growth rises with density at low density (demographic effect). A strong effect has negative growth below a threshold, a weak one does not. Causes are named: mate finding, group defence, feeding. Detection in stocks is uneven: significant depensation in 3 of 128 in Myers et al. 1995, as SCIENCES reports it.

reading.en: The need has the form of a strong effect at the demographic level, the gate its limit: at a need above the least that can renew S-11 calls it stronger than depensation as fisheries measure it; at a need of one it needs none. The point H + y is not itself an Allee threshold: it needs only giving short of the draw below y and nothing from nothing, so compensatory renewal under a fixed draw has one. 02's 'critical mass' is shapers among readers: a word match. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem: for any giving law short of a standing draw H below y, with nothing from nothing, meeting it at every z from y with z + H at most a top the step keeps, and 0 < H + y, a level up to that top ends exactly where it starts below H + y. Where giving stops below a need and the draw is positive and met at y, the point lies at least the draw above the need. Its correspondence names Allee effects under harvest; how giving depends on the draw is a premise, not a theorem.

[Dossier, AI] 'The gate puts the threshold into the premise.' At a need above the least that can renew, the gate is the limiting form of critical depensation, and how often depensation occurs bounds from above how often the later gated conclusions apply; at a need of one it bounds nothing.

Depensation is rarely detected in assessed fish stocks (Myers et al. 1995), so at the levels studied most show no need above the least that can renew at all; at that need the return T1 forbids tests nothing on those stocks.

account_adds.en: Proved in counts, the gate's threshold standing in a premise: an exact point for any giving law under its premises, how the draw raises it, and draws superadditive up to one. Tested only so far: super-additivity passed in simulated Allee yeast and is unmeasured in a real system. S-14 asks whether T1 forbids anything an Allee model of the same system does not; no live text answers.

source_adds.en: The mechanisms of low-density failure (mate finding, group defence, feeding): the account reads none, the need being supplied or measured. Then component against demographic effects, weak effects, and measured density dependence, including 207 stocks in Keith and Hutchings 2012. On yeast it passed on regimes held out from the fit, not from the analyst; 'On yeast values not read before, no frozen test of the need or of the fates it separates has passed'.

source.work: Dean, A simple model of mutualism (1983); Pimm, Food web design and the effect of species deletion (1980); Dunne, Williams and Martinez, Network structure and biodiversity loss in food webs (2002); Koh et al., Species coextinctions and the biodiversity crisis (2004)

sense.en: Dependents are lost with their partners, and deletions cascade through webs, with the reach set by web structure such as connectance. In obligate mutualism a threshold curve separates persistence from extinction, each partner needing less as the other has more. Estimates of coextinction are quantitative and model-laden, as I recall.

reading.en: In counts, these are the records' own credits. Under mutual support a point of no return does not rise as a partner rises, the threshold curve's form; along every chain of total dependence with positive draws the end of one ends everything downstream, a ring ending together or not at all. A decaying reserve lags this link by link. Dependence here is total: what the field measures is mostly partial. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem: under mutual support a point of no return does not rise as the partner rises; a condition with a positive draw, giving nothing where its partner has nothing, ends after its partner stays within its draw. Whether measured conditions are so coupled is untested.
Theorem: along every chain of total dependence with positive draws the end of one ends everything downstream, and a draw of nothing stops the cascade. How far it reaches in a field web is untested.
Where the reserve decays, coextinction runs down a chain link by link; without decay a last active step gives LPO, so the core does not state one.

Co-ending, where activity needs support, a premise leaving out buffers, reserves and lags: 'a relatum not active at a step leaves inactive there every formation whose chain of such dependence reaches it' (Web.coextinct). Lagged ending is the reserve's law.

account_adds.en: Exactness and step counts for any index type, a witness that positive draws are needed, and the constructive cost of naming when a deferred end comes.

source_adds.en: Partial dependence with a rate, the time of a cascade, robustness measures by connectance, measured webs and coextinction estimates. The record names partial dependence, a cascade's time and a measured field web as next.

source.work: Tilman, May, Lehman and Nowak, Habitat destruction and the extinction debt (1994); Kuussaari et al., Extinction debt: a challenge for biodiversity conservation (2009)

sense.en: After habitat loss, species still present can be committed to extinction, the loss arriving generations later. In Tilman and colleagues' metapopulation model the best competitors, which are poor colonizers, go first even where locally abundant, as I recall. Empirically, present richness tracks past better than present landscape in some studies, by the Kuussaari review as I recall it.

reading.en: The account never names it. Its form exists: below H + y a positive level falls every step and is nothing after as many steps as it stood, so what stands is decided under the premises; a reserve defers an end, link by link. That these are the debt is this reading's. Measured, the form is weak: of 754 fish-stock episodes below the point 63% fell, against 80% predicted, in a test whose state of the stock also failed. Yeast broke early, which does not test a long lag. [AI reading]

says.en: A positive level below H + y falls at every step, is nothing after as many steps as it stood, and stays nothing; the time to break lies in a band. Does not show that a margin times a break: yeast past its fold broke three and at least six days early.

A formation unsupported from some step on is active over any later stretch at most as often as its reserve; where the reserve decays, coextinction runs down a chain link by link. Without decay a last active step gives LPO.
MQ3's F3: under a held catch at least 80% of episodes below the regime's point were predicted to fall; 'of 754 episodes below it, 63% fell (99.5% of those above held)'. MQ3 passed 0 of 4.

account_adds.en: A proof that an end is decided before it arrives, under stated premises, and that naming when a deferred end comes without decay is a question of omniscience in the constructive logic. Nothing here measures a commitment apart from the fall itself.

source_adds.en: Competitive hierarchy, habitat fraction, species-area relations, relaxation times in generations, and the measured debt. The surprising ordering, best competitors first, has no form in the account.

source.work: Tilman, May, Lehman and Nowak, Habitat destruction and the extinction debt (1994); Kuussaari et al., Extinction debt: a challenge for biodiversity conservation (2009)

sense.en: Species now present may already be committed to loss, so present occurrence overstates what present habitat supports. Relaxation can run for many generations, longer than most surveys, by the review as I recall it.

reading.en: T1 says what persists through many renewal cycles has had the joint draw kept within the margin, and its headline gives 'many' no count. Its model does count: n steps of joint excess from a level below n + m end what depends at a need of at least m, so a large stock persists for steps while already in excess. The certificate binds only past that transient. Debt says the transient can be long in the field. No live text names this. [AI reading]

says.en: T1: 'Whatever persists through many renewal cycles' has had the joint draw kept within the regime's margin. In the model, n steps of joint excess from a level below n + m end every formation depending at a need of at least m. Beyond the model conjectured.
A positive level below H + y falls at every step and is nothing after as many steps as it stood; the time to break lies in a band. Does not show that a margin times a break.

account_adds.en: In counts the transient has a bound: persisting through n steps of joint excess shows the level stood at n + m or more, for one condition under the premises, and shows the excess absent only once the steps outrun the level.

source_adds.en: A measured relaxation time, and the claim that it can outrun observation. A persisting stock with its debt unpaid would neither support nor refute T1 until the transient ends, which bears on how a field test of T1 reads survivors.

source.work: Gyllenberg and Parvinen, Necessary and sufficient conditions for evolutionary suicide (2001); Rankin and Lopez-Sepulcre, Can adaptation lead to extinction? (2005); Rankin, Bargum and Kokko, The tragedy of the commons in evolutionary biology (2007)

sense.en: Selection, by favouring what raises individual reproductive success, can itself drive a population extinct: the invading type wins each step, and the population falls off a discontinuous transition (in adaptive-dynamics analyses, a fold, as I recall). It is stated with invasion fitness and bifurcation of the evolving trait. Laboratory cases are claimed in social microbes; I hold these thinly.

reading.en: In counts: the selection term reads how offspring numbers differ, not how many, so a positive term coexists with ending; the record names suicide a classical case. Its witness has the pattern only, reproduction stopped and the mark a label. The draw-carrying half stands apart: raising is reaching beyond, never selected against where more offspring go to raisers, itself a premise; a confined rise takes during the excess, not causing it; a group's overuse is a hypothesis. No law joins them, so the plan's 'a witness exists' overstates. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem: the witness of evolutionary suicide's pattern, reproduction simply stopped and the mark a label rather than a draw, is positive at every nonempty cohort but the last, while every member degenerates. Not shown: a suicide witness whose amount draws past the gated renewal.

Theorem (World): 'raising is reaching beyond, whose share over generations favouring raisers is never selected against'; every selection holding only where the family rises above the slack beyond holds only where a formation outside has its dependence broken. Witness Lapsing: 'selection alone does not carry the share'. Not shown: 'That more offspring go to raisers: a premise'; that the ending is a harm.
Theorem: a confined rise has no member after the end, whatever selection within had raised it to. The drawing clause says the lineage takes from the family during the excess, not that it causes it.

Theorem: a member depending at a need of at least m on a condition whose gated renewal ran into joint excess leaves no descendant from then on; one condition shared by every group ends them all and supplies none among them. Credits 'groups whose members overuse a resource of their own go extinct, while within each group selection may favour overuse'. Which group's condition runs into excess, or why, is a hypothesis.

Natural selection is claimed as one selection through couplings, the drain lying wherever room lies, crediting the commons in evolutionary biology (Rankin, Bargum and Kokko 2007): the laws proved; one law across domains conjectured (T3).

account_adds.en: Two sides of a boundary: terms positive at unboundedly many steps keep every cohort nonempty, while terms zero from some step are shared by a course that goes on and one that ends. 'selection decides what rises among the members, not whether any go on' is an AI reading in the record.

source_adds.en: The dynamic itself: a heritable draw raised by selection, causing the end through its own feedback, with invasion conditions and the discontinuity. The records name this join as not done: 'the suicide witness joined to an amount that draws past' the gated renewal, and offspring numbers tied to what a formation gives.

name.en: Relative and absolute fitness; evolutionary rescue

source.work: Wallace, Hard and soft selection revisited (1975); Gomulkiewicz and Holt, When does evolution by natural selection prevent extinction? (1995)

sense.en: Selection acts through relative differences, while persistence turns on absolute growth. In soft selection a variant gains at others' expense with total output unchanged. Evolutionary rescue is adaptation restoring positive growth before a declining population is lost, its chance depending on population size and rate of decline, in models as I recall them.

reading.en: In counts: a common number added to every offspring number leaves the selection term unmoved, so one course of terms within a horizon is shared by a course that goes on and one that ends. The record calls this the classical distinction. Rescue has only a boundary here: terms positive at unboundedly many steps keep every cohort nonempty, and which side a course is on is not decided. Soft selection stands as a reading of a witness, not a theorem. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem: the term reads how offspring numbers differ, not how many there are; within a horizon a nonempty course's terms are shared by one going on and one empty from H + 2. Which side a course is on is not decided. Its correspondence names rescue and suicide as classical cases.

Witness: in a closed family gaining nothing, a carrier's share rises from a half to the whole at constant size two by drawing on another member and a pool. Reading: the setting of Wallace's soft selection; the record says it is not a theorem.

account_adds.en: Exact statements on either side of the boundary, for any list of offspring numbers, with no rates; a pace law in which a rise of the mean with nothing flowing into the carrying lineages shrinks the population; and a reading of the record's that the source does not make here: a lineage whose descendants all change kind ends at the kind grain while descent goes on, pseudo-extinction.

source_adds.en: Stated with quantities: rescue's probability and time window, by population size, standing variation and decline rate, and measured rescue in experiments. Absolute growth rate is no quantity here, since offspring lists are supplied.

source.work: Schlaepfer, Runge and Sherman, Ecological and evolutionary traps (2002); Robertson and Hutto, A framework for understanding ecological traps (2006)

sense.en: A cue once reliable for a good option comes, after rapid environmental change, to favour a worse one: an organism prefers the option leaving it fewer offspring although better is available. Insects laying on polarizing surfaces are a stock case. The definition compares fitness across options and requires the preference to be measured.

reading.en: The account does not name this. Its nearest form was missed: under capture by counted choices, at or above its threshold a chooser takes the first policy at every step 'also where the score favours the second policy', and a change of score read late leaves the old lock. That is a preference held against its score, within one chooser, by count. Read the score as offspring number and the rule as a cue installed on ancestral courses, as training installs only along its courses: both this reading's. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (counts): under a standing score the threshold divides the counts into two regions the course never leaves; at or above it the chooser takes the first policy at every step, 'also where the score favours the second policy'. Witness: a change of score read one step late leaves the first policy locked. Premise: the rule read from the counts at the start. Not shown: that actual agents count their choices so.

Theorem (World): two histories are selected alike by every selection through a formation's couplings exactly when they are alike through them. A particular selection may ignore what its couplings carry. Near-definitional by its record's word; whether an actual selection goes through the couplings is not derived.

Theorem, on training read as selection over act laws: it installs a law only along its own courses and as far as the learner's representation lumps them; credited as the formal kernel of goal misgeneralization. It reads learners, not organisms. It says what a training can install, not what it should.
Reading [AI reading]: absolute continuation, rising relative frequency and renewal of wider conditions are different outcomes; 'a successful proxy does not make a representation true'.

targets.part: D65, Consequences select the organization that learns

account_adds.en: Proved: three choices to one keep a policy against a score weighing the other twice as much, one count moved locks the other way, and an older rule in force can carry a course against the counts; and an exact reason a selection cannot react beyond its couplings, near-definitional by its record's word, 'Known as the proxy problem' only 'in its blindness to what a proxy does not register, not its regressional or causal kinds'.

source_adds.en: The trap itself: a cue evolved over generations, a preference measured across options by fitness, rapid environmental change, and conservation practice. No law here has an inherited preference turned against offspring number across generations; that actual choosers count so is not shown, and the record credits 'five failures to induce it in humans' (de Wit and others 2018), it being insensitivity to devaluation.

name.en: Red Queen: running to stay in place

source.work: Van Valen, A new evolutionary law (1973); Dawkins and Krebs, Arms races between and within species (1979)
source.locator: locator unverified; Van Valen's zero-sum explanation of his law

sense.en: Each species' adaptive gain worsens the others' effective environment, in a roughly zero-sum world, so all must keep changing to hold their place, none gaining in the long run. Arms races are the dyadic version, asymmetric between and within species. It is a claim about interacting lineages over evolutionary time.

reading.en: The account does not state this. Its zero-sum holds by counting, whatever the amounts do; Van Valen's is a claim about the world's resources. 'Above all others' never rests for two, the nearest form of having to keep moving. A loop's form exists: in an escalation each party responds through its couplings and the difference returns, and around a loop the most difference that can arrive multiplies. A bound only; no law has two lineages each changing the other's selection. In the one race played, drawers in turn, the stock ends. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem, any type for the counting: across every change of amounts the positions' rises total their falls; no change raises every part's position.
Theorem: 'above all others' is met by at most one seeker, so no unchanged state meets it for two. How a target forms is not modelled.

Theorem: among two drawers or more, where what stands from nothing is at most what stands from anything left, every profile perfect for position draws everything before the horizon. It does not show that actual races are so played. Credited: relative-payoff maximizers (Schaffer 1988) and spite (Hamilton 1970).

Theorem: where every formation outside a part responds through its couplings, two flows compare within its responsive reach. Responding so is supplied. The record's reading, the AI's: an escalation loop is the case where each party responds through its couplings and the difference returns to the part. No ranking of the flows is stated: order would need C or a premise in its place, and scope the continuation condition, neither asserted.

Theorem (World): with strengths in whole numbers a loop multiplies the carried amount at least by one plus their product per turn; the gap is polynomial exactly where no loop lies upstream. Not shown: 'That a particular law runs away around a loop'; the runaway is of the most difference that can arrive, and a law exchanging nothing has none.

account_adds.en: Proved: position's rises total its falls for any amounts; and a race for position ending the stock it draws on, over any renewal law, in a game among drawers rather than lineages. That a race produces joint excess is a premise elsewhere.

source_adds.en: Reciprocal evolutionary change between lineages, with its dynamics; asymmetries of arms races between and within species; and the zero-sum as a claim about the world, where in the account it comes with position's definition. The record lists as next 'a race dynamic in which parts behind raise their take, and whether it produces joint excess'.

name.en: Van Valen's law of constant extinction

source.work: Van Valen, A new evolutionary law (1973)

sense.en: From fossil taxa: within an ecologically related group, the probability of extinction is roughly constant in time, independent of a taxon's age, so survivorship curves are log-linear. It is an empirical regularity with quantities, later challenged and refined; I do not hold its present standing in detail. Hamilton's Red Queen theory of sex is a further and separate claim.

reading.en: Nothing in the account states a hazard independent of age, and its laws of ending read a stock against a draw, not a taxon's survivorship. The nearest forms are thin: in the exit from a margin a record bears on the exit only through the margin it shows and the steps left, a bound on weights, not a rate; and the record's reading of pseudo-extinction bears on what taxon survivorship counts, not on its rate. Not a defect; a field's measured law the account has not taken up. [AI reading]

source_adds.en: A measured, falsifiable, age-independent rate across taxa: the kind of quantity the account's verdict says it lacks.

searched: Red Queen, Van Valen, survivorship, hazard, across the front pages, chapters, review and record pages: no hit in the sense of a rate
taxon, pseudo-extinction: chapters, review and record pages
read: 02-MAP.md T1's statement and the exit from a margin

name.en: Fisherian runaway: preference carried with what it prefers

source.work: Fisher, The Genetical Theory of Natural Selection (1930), on sexual selection; Lande, Models of speciation by sexual selection on polygenic traits (1981)

sense.en: Choosers' offspring inherit both the preference and the preferred trait, so the two become correlated. Selection on the trait by choice then raises the preference, which strengthens selection on the trait: a self-reinforcing process with no need of any benefit to viability. Lande treats it with quantitative genetics: a genetic covariance, a line of equilibria.

reading.en: The account has no sexual selection. The self-reference has a form in counts: a rule read monotonically from the share it selects locks; readers drawn from the selected move that premise to who reads; with lo below c below hi, a critical mass divides two locks. Yet one share collapses two linked traits, and the rule is read, not inherited through a covariance. Agreement of loop shape only. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type): with selection not lowering a share under a favouring rule, the rule read monotonically from the share, and the start's rule and every rule read favouring, the share falls at no step and the course locks. That actual rules read the share is the premise.
Theorem: the rule read as the pool of its readers' readings is monotone in the share exactly where the others' reading is not above the carriers'.

Theorem (counts): with lo <= hi a share decides exactly where lo < c < hi. That readers are drawn from those selected, and read so, is not shown: 'the premise is moved to who reads, not removed'. Its correspondence names a stag hunt and, as a biological comparator for readers favouring their own kind, the greenbeard ('only the bibliographic record verified').

account_adds.en: Exact conditions in counts for a lock on either side of a critical mass; drawn one member at a time, either lock is left by drift, at a weight whose bound falls across the distance from the mass.

source_adds.en: Two traits and their genetic covariance, the line of equilibria, the ratio of variances deciding instability, exaggeration as continuing change of a trait's value, speciation consequences, the rival handicap argument (Zahavi 1975).

name.en: Fisherian runaway is not closed capture

source.work: Lande, Models of speciation by sexual selection on polygenic traits (1981); Kirkpatrick, Sexual selection and the evolution of female choice (1982)
source.locator: locator unverified; the balance of sexual selection against viability selection

sense.en: The trait's viability cost acts on the same offspring numbers as choice does. The runaway stops where the two balance, or, past the line of equilibria's stability, goes until cost halts it. Cost is inside the selection, not unread by it.

reading.en: The plan seeds this as 'closed capture by preference'. Closed capture's lock outlives a loss because neither next share nor rule read reads it (Unread). In the Fisher-Lande setting a viability loss enters the counts that make the share, so Unread fails and that law does not apply. Nearer is drawn shaping, whose cost is read against hi and lo, with a balance at the critical mass, unstable there. The account's 'runaway' is how far a break is, or the most difference a loop can carry: neither a trait's escalation. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem: where neither next share nor rule read reads the beyond (Unread), courses alike in share and rule stay alike; under the further premises the loss passes every bound while the course stays locked. A reading favouring at no loss above a bound unlocks the course, a sufficient way out.

Theorem (counts): at a share the rule read favours the shapers exactly where x.carrier c + x.other c <= x.carrier hi + x.other lo, so the cost is inside what selects; in the stag-hunt reading others leave a + p + c and shapers a + p + hi or a + p + lo. Witness: at one to two each kind leaves six and the share stays. 'The critical mass is its mixed equilibrium.'

A second 'runaway': 'the runaway is of the most difference that can arrive', around a loop with strengths in whole numbers, an upper bound over laws. 'a law exchanging nothing is within every strength and has no runaway, loop or not'. A distance to a break is the other (runaway-distance-uncoupled, where 'a runaway remains a reading').

account_adds.en: The exact condition, Unread, that tells a loss a loop can outlive from one it cannot; the Fisher case falls on the far side of it. And a read cost in counts: at one to two each kind leaves six and the share stays, the boundary between two locks.

source_adds.en: A self-reinforcing loop whose cost is read and which comes to a stable rest by a balance of two selections in one term, or lies along a line of equilibria: neither is stated, the balance stated here being the unstable one between locks. Readers who learn, and a cost changing with the share, are named as not done.

source.work: Maynard Smith and Szathmary, The Major Transitions in Evolution (1995); Michod, Darwinian Dynamics (1999)
source.locator: the book's opening chapter on common features; locator unverified

sense.en: Entities that replicated alone come to replicate only as parts of a larger whole, with new ways of storing and passing information: genes into genomes, cells into organisms, organisms into societies, language. Common features recur: division of labour, contingent irreversibility, conflict suppressed. Michod reads these as fitness moving between levels.

reading.en: The account holds what follows a transition: levels partitioned in counts, a founding's bottleneck and sequestration as hypotheses. One periphery model has clonal groups forming by division with bonds, with no fitted rate. How parts first come to live as one it does not hold, and 04 says why its group laws do not reach it; what agrees is conflict after a whole has formed, the germ-line entry's. Its reading that cell, organ, body, ecosystem is one case, not a fixed ladder, is thin as a divergence: Maynard Smith and Szathmary do not claim inevitability, as I recall. [AI reading]

says.en: Over wholes each founded by one part, where every next founder carries its founder's value (a hypothesis stating an outcome), the mean founding value rises exactly where selection among wholes goes for it. Does not show how parts first come to live as one.
Theorem: the law of total covariance with size weights, in counts; how the next cohort is listed fixes the next step's among-group part.

Theorem (periphery): where division copies retention and adds a bond, positions connected by actual bonds share a founder; aggregation is the counterexample. A common founder is not constant genotype or shared interest.

The chapter does not show how parts first come to live as one, wholes founded by several parts, removal of parts by a whole's rule, or how groups and couplings form beyond the bonded model of section 5.

'the forming of an organized individual is not explained by changing the partition of a population already supplied, which is all the group laws of §5 read.' Reading [AI reading]: inclusion, functional participation and dependence are distinct relations; cell, organ, body, ecosystem is one biological case, not a fixed ladder.

targets.part: What happens, and D65, Part and whole

says.en: Open, among the programme's requirements: 'formation of evolving organization' and 'novel organization and changed units'. A candidate explanation stands there, 'not a theorem'; completing one requirement does not complete the whole.

account_adds.en: Proved: a rise confined to its whole ends with it whatever selection within raised it to, and a witness in which a variant selected within lowers the mean founding value. Both take the whole as already formed.

source_adds.en: The transitions themselves, which the record lists as not shown: 'How parts first come to live as one (the major transitions themselves)'. So too division of labour, new inheritance systems, irreversibility, aggregative and colonial routes, policing. The 'novel organization and changed units' requirement stays open in 04's own list.

name.en: The germ line and cancer as conflict within a body

source.work: Buss, The Evolution of Individuality (1987); Michod and Roze, Cooperation and conflict in the evolution of multicellularity (2001); Aktipis et al., Cancer across the tree of life (2015)

sense.en: Selection among cell lineages within a body runs against selection among bodies. A single-cell bottleneck and a sequestered germ line reduce that conflict, and cancer reads as cheating on multicellular cooperation. These are mechanistic and comparative claims, with measured cases across taxa.

reading.en: 04 says these laws restate known results on cancer and the germ line, with the flow. A rise is a lineage selection within goes for, drawing during its family's excess; confined, it has no member after the end. Over wholes each founded by one part, with every next founder carrying its founder's value, an outcome and not a mechanism, the mean founding value rises exactly where selection among wholes goes for it. ConfinedRise as cancer, Sequestered as germ line and Founded as bottleneck are the record's AI readings. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (World; any type for the founding laws): a confined rise has no member after the end, whatever selection within raised it to. Sequestered is a hypothesis stating an outcome. Without it, in a witness, a variant selected within lowers the mean founding value from a half to none. That a tumour meets the clauses is empirical.

account_adds.en: The transmission and ending laws joined on one flow. Not a ranking: the record says that a lineage ending with its whole is worse, or sequestration better, is not shown; ranking would need C or a premise in its place for order, with the continuation condition for scope, neither asserted, their warrant open.

source_adds.en: How a germ line is sequestered and how far it varies, removal of parts by a whole's rule (policing), wholes founded by several parts, transmissible cancers beyond one generation's witness, and every measured rate.

source.work: Wright, Tempo and mode in evolution (1945); Maynard Smith, Group selection and kin selection (1964); Levins, Extinction (1970); Wilson, A theory of group selection (1975); Wilson and Sober, Reintroducing group selection to the human behavioral sciences (1994)

sense.en: A trait selected against within groups can spread if groups with more of it last or produce more. This needs variance among groups, which group formation must regenerate, as in the haystack model and trait groups. How often it matters, and whether it differs from kin selection, has been argued for decades.

reading.en: In counts: the multilevel partition at any size weights, in which how the next cohort is listed fixes the next step's among-group part, and a step can use that part up. Which level wins is read off the counts, not explained. On the World, ending can supply the among-group part where each group has its own gated condition; one condition shared by all, or one coupled family, supplies none. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem: the law of total covariance with size weights; how the next cohort is listed fixes the next step's among-group part. Credits the haystack model and trait groups.

Where every group with less leaves no offspring, nothing is discordant among groups, the whole still selecting by the within-group counts. One condition shared by every group ends them all. Credits Wright 1945, Levins 1970 and Wilson and Sober 1994. How groups form, or that keeping is better, is not shown.
Theorem (World): groups depending on one coupled family end together, nothing selected among them: ending selects only between families. Mixing between groups is not stated.

account_adds.en: Exact counts for the split, the either-verdict witnesses from the same within-group counts, and which grouping of conditions lets ending select at all. Ending does not settle the whole: with the other group ended, a groupmate leaving five against one holding back leaving one makes the whole select against holding back (Outweighs).

source_adds.en: The empirical question of when among-group selection is strong enough; group formation as a process; migration and group reproduction with their rates (Traulsen and Nowak 2006, named at 08).

source.work: Hamilton, The genetical evolution of social behaviour (1964); Hamilton, Innate social aptitudes of man (1975); Queller, Kinship, reciprocity and synergism (1985)

sense.en: A costly trait spreads where relatedness times benefit exceeds cost, rb > c. r is a statistical measure of genetic association between actor and recipient, in the 1975 paper read through the Price equation among groups. Queller adds a synergy term. Field studies estimate r, b and c as quantities.

reading.en: In counts, nothing subtracted, with exact transmission for the step law: for equal groups and additive returns, the whole selects for keeping exactly where (b + c) times its spread falls short of mb times the spread among groups, with the assortment the share among groups. A general additive form needs no groups. It is restated, not improved, by the account's own verdict. How groups are founded and how the share among them changes enter as given; groups formed by descent are the complete-assortment case. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type), exact transmission for the step law: this is Hamilton's rule, in counts with nothing subtracted; its general additive form holds on any list. Synergy is not stated, nor which sharing actual groups have, which is a premise.

Theorem: with exact transmission, groups formed by descent from uniform groups keep their values; nothing is selected within them. Correspondence: Hamilton 1975's assortment, 'clonal groups, the haystack limit'. Not stated: how assortment changes over generations; why lower lineages end is a hypothesis.

Theorem (counts): at unequal sizes, where each member gains for every unit its group holds, two listings with the same spreads give either verdict; the verdict goes through the covariance of a member's group total with its group's mean.
Restated in counts. Prior work states what the account does not yet: Hamilton's rule with synergy (Queller 1985) and with assortment changing over generations.

targets.part: the evolution-line row on what prior work states

account_adds.en: The kept form, K < s + mq times rho, in which what comes back alone counts at every assortment, and the unequal-size witness. Shaping a rule is a case of it, which carries the rule outside biology.

source_adds.en: r as genetic association by descent, synergy, class structure, measured r, b and c, and the kin-against-group dispute (Nowak, Tarnita and Wilson 2010 and replies, as I recall). The account takes no side beyond a correspondence crediting additive equivalence (Queller 1992; Okasha 2006). No regression coefficient is formed in the record; 04 reads the verdict through a regression only over the rationals.

source.work: Hamilton (1964) on inclusive fitness; Grafen, Optimization of inclusive fitness (2006)

sense.en: In the field's frame, selection makes organisms appear to maximize inclusive fitness: a quantity attributable to an individual, under which an organism's adaptations are read as design. Formal Darwinism aims to link gene-frequency change and optimization formally. Its scope is argued, and others dispute inclusive fitness's generality.

reading.en: The account does not take up the claim. It does not define fitness, and 04 says offspring number is 'a weight and a reading, never a measure of worth'. That refuses authority, which the field's claim does not ask: the field's is an explanatory quantity. So the divergence is what is stated: organism-level optimization has no law here, and optimization is the field's frame. Where evaluation enters, it rests on two premises, neither asserted: the continuation condition for scope and C for order. [AI reading]

says.en: Not shown: that any amount, lineage, group or level of selection is better; fitness, rational amounts beyond a common denominator, or a new population-genetic prediction.
Fitness is not defined, and no reproductive advantage is ethical authority. It adds no new population-genetic prediction.

The rule reads the counts; that keeping is better where it is selected for is not shown, and ranking goes through the comparison C or a premise in its place. Correspondence: 'the equivalence of multilevel and inclusive-fitness accounts for additive returns (Queller 1992; Okasha 2006)'.
The dossier asks reviewers whether stating these laws in whole numbers, with offspring lists supplied and fitness not defined, loses anything that matters. Open.

account_adds.en: What 04 states: 'Fitness is not defined, and no reproductive advantage is ethical authority.' The only live mention of inclusive fitness is one correspondence credit of additive equivalence, for groupmates' returns. 04 section 8's caution on inference is the separate entry on adaptationist inference.

source_adds.en: An individual-level design quantity, and the adaptationist explanatory practice built on it. A biologist could say the account gives up a tool that explains organisms' fit.

source.work: Price, Selection and covariance (1970); Price, Extension of covariance selection mathematics (1972)

sense.en: Change in a mean trait equals the covariance of fitness and trait, plus the fitness-weighted expected change in transmission, over mean fitness. It is an exact identity for any population with a parent-offspring mapping, recursively expandable across levels. Whether an identity explains anything is argued in the field (Frank 2012; van Veelen, as I recall).

reading.en: In counts: an identity of natural numbers over finite lists, with no premise, the differences truncated, the covariance's denominators cleared, the multilevel form at any size weights. The account credits substance elsewhere: its record calls this an identity checked 'without improving it'. Real-valued traits and expectations are not its form. What is new is only the join to support and flow. [AI reading]

says.en: Price's equation in counting form: over any finite family and natural-number amounts, the offspring's total with what transmission lowered is each parent's amount counted once per offspring with what transmission raised. No premise.
With no premise, the covariance with its denominators cleared; over cohorts the mean is kept across a step exactly where selection proper and transmission balance.

In a family closed, balanced and dissipated on, a lineage that reproduced at first has a step at which transmission lowered offspring number by more than selection and what transmission raised. Whether actual lineages lie within such families is an application question.

account_adds.en: The flow beside the identity: only the supported leave descendants, and Price's transmission term must at some step outweigh selection in a closed, dissipating family. The audit calls that third part known as the Malthusian bound.

source_adds.en: Real-valued traits, expected transmission as a term of a statistical population, and Price's later general frame for selection, which I recall only thinly.

source.work: Fisher, The Genetical Theory of Natural Selection (1930); Price, Fisher's 'fundamental theorem' made clear (1972)

sense.en: The rate of increase of mean fitness due to natural selection equals the additive genetic variance in fitness. As Price clarified, this is the partial change only; the environment's own change, which can fully offset it, stands apart. So total mean fitness need not rise.

reading.en: In counts: with exact transmission the mean offspring number rises exactly where offspring numbers vary; with breeding values given by the normal equations, transmitted exactly, the mean breeding value rises by the additive variance over the mean offspring number, cross-multiplied. So it holds where nothing but selection changes things. The environment term, Fisher's partial-change sense, is marked not stated in general, though one case stands: with nothing flowing in, offspring numbers are uniform, which a record reads as Fisher's deterioration of the environment. [AI reading]

says.en: Fisher's theorem in counts, exact case: with exact transmission, the mean offspring number rises across a step exactly where offspring numbers vary and is kept exactly where they are uniform.
Fisher's fundamental theorem with breeding values. That the normal equations have such a solution is given, not shown; inexact transmission of the breeding value is not stated.
Prior work states what the account does not yet: Fisher's theorem under inexact transmission, with the environment term (Price 1972), and a solution of the normal equations.

targets.part: the evolution-line row on what prior work states

says.en: Theorem: 'with nothing flowing in, offspring numbers are uniform' (number_unfed_uniform). Its correspondence: 'density regulation of heritable variance in fitness in counts, Fisher's deterioration of the environment as Price... read it', and of Price's and Fisher's identities, that they 'admit every pace; the flow bounds them'.

account_adds.en: Proved in counts: a witness on four members where a breeding value's spread is 32 against the whole's 48, so part of the variance is left over; and, in a balanced, dissipating family, a step at which transmission lowered offspring number by more than selection and what transmission raised.

source_adds.en: The environment term's meaning, which is the theorem's point in Price's reading; a solved regression, and real-valued variance as a rate. Stated with a rate, the theorem is a quantitative claim the counting form only cross-multiplies.

source.work: Wright, Evolution in Mendelian populations (1931); Moran, Random processes in genetics (1958); Kimura, Evolutionary rate at the molecular level (1968)

sense.en: In a finite population gene frequencies change by sampling alone. A neutral allele fixes with probability equal to its starting share, in a time of order the population size, and the neutral rate of substitution equals the mutation rate. With selection, fixation probability has a closed form in s and N.

reading.en: In counts: drawing histories weighed by ways of drawing, with no chance of the unfolding supposed. Summed over histories drift has no direction, and the histories fixing a kind are bounded both ways by its starting share. The limit is read from finite bounds, not proved. Moran's ratio stands for the jump chain. 08's verdict is 'restated as finite weighted bounds', and 04 says it adds no new population-genetic prediction. [AI reading]

says.en: Finite weighted bounds, whose reading is that the fixing share tends to h/N. Constant N at least 2, no selection or mutation in the draw; the time to fixation bounded, not stated.
For the count-changing jump chain of the Moran process, fixing histories are bounded by the ratio that is the Moran probability in counts. Wright-Fisher with selection not stated.
Prior work states what the account does not yet: Kimura's fixation with selection in sampled generations, the neutral rate of substitution, drift's time scales.

targets.part: the evolution-line row on drift, fixation and mutation

account_adds.en: Bounds with no probability taken as primitive, and, for a rule read at each count, a witness where the Moran criterion parts from risk dominance.

source_adds.en: Every quantity the field is used for: the substitution rate, heterozygosity's loss by 1 - 1/N a generation, fixation time, effective population size and the molecular clock.

source.work: Gause, The Struggle for Existence (1934); Hardin, The competitive exclusion principle (1960); Tilman, Resource Competition and Community Structure (1982)

sense.en: Complete competitors for one limiting resource cannot coexist at equilibrium. In Tilman's resource-ratio form, the species drawing the resource lowest wins, a measurable R*. Hutchinson's paradox of the plankton and later coexistence theory ask why so many in fact coexist: fluctuation, partitioning and stabilizing differences.

reading.en: The record calls its law 'the form here' of the principle 'where one formation takes the whole renewal'. In the World, under the gate: a full taker continuing leaves no named other taking through all of a window one step longer than the level. Taking all is a premise; who becomes the full taker is not derived. A divergence: with both still taking, the excess ends every formation at the need, the full taker included. A taker outlasts where the other stops, not by what the field reads as winning at a lower R*. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (World; the gate at the need): where a formation takes all that is given and is active at every step, not at every one of the level + 1 steps from T is a named other present and taking. Where renewal depends on what it renews, 'full taking alongside another taker at each of n steps, from a level below n + m, ends every formation depending on the condition at a need of at least m, the full taker included'. Taking jointly within what is given keeps the level.

account_adds.en: Taking jointly within what is given at every step keeps the level, and every formation depending on that condition alone at a need met at the start stays supported; the levels still admit the excluded.

source_adds.en: Which competitor wins, by a measured R* or a growth rate; coexistence mechanisms with their quantities; the equilibrium assumption the principle rests on. The account's law predicts no outcome between two competitors, and 'How taking all that is given forms' is listed as not shown.

source.work: Levins, Some demographic and genetic consequences of environmental heterogeneity for biological control (1969); Hanski, Metapopulation dynamics (1998)

sense.en: A species can persist across patches though each goes extinct, by the balance of colonization and local extinction; occupancy settles at one minus the ratio of the two rates, and persists only if colonization outruns extinction. Rescue effects and landscape connectivity refine this with measured quantities.

reading.en: The account reads the deficit side: a patch renewed by a neighbour shows no excess alone, and under the coupled gate the pair ends as one, nothing selected among groups on it. Nearest to recolonization: a formation renewed from outside can be active again, and in one learners' commons a patch regrew after reaching nothing. Persistence through asynchronous turnover, Levins's claim, is not stated: there the mechanism parts. The record's gloss read patches as persisting or going extinct together, which fits this law and not Levins, whose patches end apart; since 7 November 2026 the record says they go extinct apart and are recolonized. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (World): under the coupled gate, n steps of family excess from a stock below n + m end every formation depending on a member at such a need; a patch renewed by a neighbour shows no excess read alone; both end read as one. The scope prediction tests the identification, not the dynamics.

Of two patches within the regrowth radius, 'joint excess on one patch read alone does not end its renewal (all 679 windows violated, 100 of 100 runs regrow after reaching 0). Read as one condition, the two patches meet the law.' A formation renewed from outside can be active again (Restored.returns).

account_adds.en: The grain of reading decides whether a deficit shows, tested in one learners' commons: 'all 679 windows violated, 100 of 100 runs regrow after reaching 0' on one patch read alone, while the two read as one meet the law. The family law's tightness is listed as not shown.

source_adds.en: Persistence through extinction and recolonization, the claim itself, stated with quantities: occupancy at one minus the rates' ratio, the persistence threshold, rescue and connectivity measures. In the account a patch's ending and a family's are one kind of law, with no recolonization rate.

source.work: Odling-Smee, Laland and Feldman, Niche Construction: The Neglected Process in Evolution (2003)

sense.en: Organisms change their own selective environment, and later generations inherit the changed conditions: an ecological inheritance alongside genes. Models show lags and momentum in response. The proponents read this as a second causal route, which others call a mere consequence of standard theory.

reading.en: The account has the formal half. Under the reading of drawing, a dependence forms anew at a descent exactly where the giver drew on what it did not depend on; activity lowers a pool a descendant's support then reads; a capacity to shape the rule is selected by what comes back. All premised; the law says where a dependence comes from, not why. The laws take no side on the extended synthesis and cover drawing down, not building up; 04's open list holds a candidate leaning toward it. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (World): under the reading of drawing at the descent, a hypothesis, a dependence forms anew exactly where the giver drew on what it did not depend on. The law says where a new dependence comes from, not why.
One unfolding (witness): transmission, variation, selection and the feedback of activity on selection, in a parent whose taking lowers the pool an inheriting descendant needs.
Theorem (counts): at a step the rule favours the shapers (weakly) exactly where c <= s, whatever p comes to every member alike; with nothing coming back and a cost, their share falls strictly.

'The candidate explanation, not a theorem': differences enter later activity through actual transmission and 'change the conditions of variation, development, shared living and later selection, so that the organization of evolution itself changes within the unfolding'.

account_adds.en: With balance and inheritance at the descents, transmission lets descent vary a need and drop a dependence, never add one nothing taking part held; and what every member receives alike does not change which way the rule favours.

source_adds.en: The claim that it is a causal route equal to selection; building up, where the laws cover drawing down; ecological inheritance as a population-genetic variable, its time-lag dynamics, empirical cases. The open list names 'evolution of the conditions of evolution' as unfinished.

source.work: Bedau et al., Open problems in artificial life (2000); Banzhaf et al., Defining and simulating open-ended novelty (2016); Taylor et al., Open-ended evolution: perspectives from the OEE workshop in York (2016); Adams et al., Formal definitions of unbounded evolution and innovation (2017)

sense.en: Evolution on Earth keeps producing novelty with no evident bound, and artificial systems so far do not. Definitions vary: unbounded change against an isolated system's recurrence, or innovation that changes the model and so the possibilities of variation. No agreed test exists, as I recall.

reading.en: 08 calls the laws restatements. A course keeping widening by name, with fixed finite requirements, needs a stock passing every bound, fed from beyond, and a finite balanced world has none. That the possible with what is held grows only across a change of what is held holds by definition. Widening here is a relation between courses; its being better is C, with scope from the continuation condition, neither asserted. 08 says the possible within a horizon restates the adjacent possible for a prestated space only. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (World; witnesses): the family's stock passes every bound, and a finite balanced world under the first law has no such course. No law here compares two courses; renewal does not give widening.

Theorem (any process): 'The possible relative to what is held grows only across steps changing what is held, and keeps widening only where what is held changes without end. Along a course of a stated process nothing is added to the whole possible.' Credits Banzhaf and others 2016, where it 'holds there by definition'.

08's list: restated; 'as open-ended evolution measures unbounded evolution against an isolated system's recurrence'; the innovation law 'holds there by definition'. The adjacent possible is restated for a prestated space only.

targets.part: the list row on open-ended evolution and the adjacent possible

says.en: Open: novel organization and changed units; evolution of the conditions of evolution.

[Dossier] 'what the first theorem counts as new is new by name, not by descent. Measures of open-endedness count new kinds or lineages. The laws state a beginning, and a witness within kinds given in advance; no law here counts new kinds.'

account_adds.en: The constraint from the flow: a witness that renewal alone can go on while what it forms by name only returns. And a limit that bears on the field's measures: 'what the first theorem counts as new is new by name, not by descent'.

source_adds.en: What makes biological evolution open-ended: no law here gives the mechanism, 'no law here counts new kinds', and 04's open list holds a candidate explanation, 'not a theorem'. Measures of novelty on data, and novelty that cannot be prestated (Longo, Montevil and Kauffman 2012, named at 08).

source.work: Lovelock and Margulis, Atmospheric homeostasis by and for the biosphere (1974); Watson and Lovelock, Biological homeostasis of the global environment: the parable of Daisyworld (1983); Doolittle, Natural selection through survival alone, and the possibility of Gaia (2014)

sense.en: Life with its environment regulates planetary conditions in ways that keep them habitable. Daisyworld shows regulation with no foresight or selection for it; Doolittle argues persistence alone could select such systems. Critics deny any general tendency, and Ward's Medea hypothesis argues the reverse, as I recall.

reading.en: The account does not name this, and its laws do not give the tendency. A form of regulation exists: where each condition's exchange opposes departure from its own level, a family's stock settles at the total, nothing reading the total. Against the strong form, selection is blind beyond its couplings, and one condition shared by every group supplies no selection among them, the form of the one-Earth objection Doolittle answers, as I recall it. T1 filters what persisted; it does not say persisting regulates. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (World): the family's stock is the total of those levels from the step every condition has settled, nothing reading the total; opposition alone permits overshoot.
Theorem (World; balance on what couples in): with the rest fixed, selection is blind beyond the coupling closure. Near-definitional by its record's word.

Reading [AI reading]: absolute continuation, rising relative frequency and renewal of wider conditions are different outcomes; unconditional convergence toward renewal of the whole is not established.

targets.part: D65, Consequences select the organization that learns

says.en: Theorem: 'one condition shared by every group ends them all and supplies no selection among them'. It reads groups, not a planet; the application to a single biosphere is this reading's.
T1: 'Whatever persists through many renewal cycles' has had the joint draw kept within the regime's margin. Beyond the model conjectured. A condition on what persisted, no claim of a tendency.

account_adds.en: A law in which a total is kept with no reader of the total, under premises on each condition, stating no direction. No dynamic is good or bad here.

source_adds.en: A claim of tendency at the scale of a planet, its feedback cases and their quantities. The account has none, and whether life tends to keep its conditions would be an empirical claim it does not make.

name.en: Malthusian limits and the cost of selection

source.work: Malthus, An Essay on the Principle of Population (1798); Haldane, The cost of natural selection (1957); Nei (1971); Felsenstein (1971)

sense.en: Reproduction outruns what sustains it, so numbers are checked by what is available. Haldane counts the selective deaths a substitution costs, which limits how fast substitutions can go; Nei and Felsenstein restate the limit from a reproductive excess. These are claims with rates about populations; how far the limit binds has been disputed, as I recall.

reading.en: In counts, and by the account's own word restated: each offspring given at least one unit, a lineage within a family balanced and dissipated on reproduces at most its starting stock many steps; where something flows in, the bounds read only its stock and what flows in. A cap on each parent bounds one substitution's steps. 08 calls the third part against Price and Fisher 'yes and weak, carried by its premises', and the natural statement, 'a pace bounded by what flows into the whole, is false'. The 04 reading says this is Malthus's limit on carrying lineages, and not Haldane's cost. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem: offspring numbers are bounded by what is given and taken; a lineage within a family dissipated on ends within its stock. Correspondence: 'That a finite closed resource ends reproduction is the Malthusian bound.' Where something flows in, the bounds read only its stock and what flows in.

Reading [AI reading, D45]: 'Malthus's limit read on the lineages carrying an amount'; the per-parent form is behind the limit of Nei and Felsenstein, 'in counts, and not the spacing of successive substitutions that limit states. It is not Haldane's cost (1957), which counts selective deaths'.

'the third part against Price and Fisher is yes and weak, carried by its premises. The natural statement, a pace bounded by what flows into the whole, is false: a part of a closed whole rises by drawing on the rest.'

Over cohorts of descent within a family balanced and dissipated on at each step, a lineage reproduces at most the starting stock many steps and then ends. Whether actual lineages lie within such families is an application question.

account_adds.en: The bound joined to flow: identities that admit every pace are bounded by what flows in, and a witness that a part of a closed whole can rise by drawing on the rest.

source_adds.en: Malthus's ratios and checks; selective deaths as a quantity; the spacing of successive substitutions; measured substitution rates and whether the limit binds. Any population's actual closure is left as an application question.

name.en: Maximum sustainable yield, open access and optimal depletion

source.work: Schaefer (1954); Gordon, The economic theory of a common-property resource (1954); Scott (1955); Clark, Profit maximization and the extinction of animal species (1973); Clark, Mathematical Bioeconomics (1976)

sense.en: A logistic stock yields most at an interior level; a sole owner maximizing rent holds above it; open access drives rent to nothing, settling at a positive stock where revenue meets cost, the bionomic equilibrium. Clark shows that a discount rate above the stock's growth can make extinction optimal, where price exceeds the cost of harvesting at low stock.

reading.en: In counts, over orders: every optimum of every order rising with the total drawn holds a level of greatest renewal before the last step and leaves nothing at the end; a weight falling faster than any level renews leaves nothing; others drawing first end the stock at once; re-optimizing above a renewal loses the dependence for good. No cost of drawing is represented, so the Gordon and Clark readings are limits at zero cost, by the dossier's own note. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any renewal law; the breaks on the World): every optimum of every order rising with the total drawn holds a level of greatest renewal at every step before the last and leaves nothing at the end, given reach and capacity. Limit: 'with a discount the optimum may hold below the levels of greatest renewal.'

Theorem: where a later step's weight falls faster than any positive level can renew, every optimum leaves nothing from the first step to the n-th; conversely it leaves something where a level renews faster. 'the discrete form of a discount rate above the greatest rate of renewal making extinction optimal'.

Theorem: where others first draw from what an optimizer leaves, by a rule supplied, every optimum of an order whose weighting falls at every step ends the stock at once, over a horizon of at least two steps. In a witness, 'the discrete form of open access dissipating what a sole owner would keep (Gordon 1954)'.

Theorem: a dependence renewed by r at its need is lost exactly where the draw exceeds r, for good. Not shown: a renewal varying with the level at or above the need, logistic growth with an interior yield; 'That the loss is a harm'. Credits: 'The maximum sustainable yield (Schaefer 1954) is the largest draw kept'.

[Dossier, AI] 'No cost of drawing is represented'; 'In bioeconomics the cost decides both results quoted': Clark's extinction needs a price above the cost of harvesting at low stock, and with a positive cost Gordon's open access settles at a positive stock, not at nothing. 'The two quoted readings are their limits at zero cost.' The audit's verdict: known in bioeconomics.

account_adds.en: The laws read every order rising with what couples in, not one objective, and at a mutual best response several optimizers stand as one of joint capacity. No law says which course to take: a ranking would need C, or a premise in its place, for order and the continuation condition for scope, neither asserted, warrant open.

source_adds.en: Effort, price and cost, with the positive stock open access settles at; logistic and interior yields in the re-optimizing law; discounted optima holding below the level of greatest renewal; every measured fishery. Ending at nothing, read as open access or optimal extinction, comes with zero cost in these laws.

name.en: Trophic cascades: effects through what responds

source.work: Hairston, Smith and Slobodkin, Community structure, population control, and competition (1960); Paine, Food webs: linkage, interaction strength and community infrastructure (1980); Estes et al., Trophic downgrading of planet Earth (2011)

sense.en: A change at one level of a food web reaches levels it does not touch, through those between: predators release or suppress plants through herbivores. Strength varies widely across lakes, kelp forests and wolves, as I recall; how much is top-down or bottom-up, and particular cases such as Yellowstone, are disputed.

reading.en: A witness with laws, not an ecology. With the rest of the exchange fixed, the wolves' part does not reach the forest and the comparison shows nothing; against a flow in which the rest responds, the forest lies within the responsive reach and the difference arrives. So a cascade reads as the gap between two counterfactuals. The responding flow is supplied and responding through couplings is a premise. By the record 'trophic cascade' is 'the ecological term', the names the AI's. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem: the comparison of any two flows is decided within what their difference reaches. 'With the rest of the exchange fixed, effects through others' responses do not show in the comparison (Trophic.mediated_uncoupled).' Significance stays supplied; the general theorems do not use the continuation condition.

Theorem: where every formation outside a part responds through its couplings, two flows compare within its responsive reach, an upper bound. 'in the trophic cascade the wolves' part does not reach the forest, while the forest lies within the wolves' responsive reach'. Responding so is supplied.

Theorem: the feeding closure lies within the influence closure, each inclusion possibly strict. In Trophic, 'the wolves give to nothing, lying beyond the forest's feeding closure and within its influence closure'.

account_adds.en: The kind of counterfactual decides what shows, and a bound on where a difference can arrive. Neither says which formations it reaches, nor how much. Any ranking of the two flows would need C, or a premise in its place, for order and the continuation condition for scope, neither asserted, warrant open.

source_adds.en: Strengths and what sets them, top-down against bottom-up control, keystone species, measured cases and their disputes. Nothing here predicts that a given web cascades, since the flows are supplied.

source.work: Darwin, On the Origin of Species (1859); Williams, Adaptation and Natural Selection (1966)

sense.en: Selection acts on present differences in reproduction, with no view of future good or the good of the group. Williams argues that adaptation should be invoked only where needed, and that group benefit does not follow from what individual selection builds. A framing for explanation, with no exact theorem claimed.

reading.en: The law of this form: histories alike through a formation's couplings are selected alike, so with the rest fixed and balance on what couples in, selection is blind beyond its coupling closure. Its record calls this near-definitional, 'the blindness a one-line corollary', and whether an actual selection goes through the couplings is underived. On the flow a selection rewarding a rise does not see what it breaks beyond. The form agrees; Darwin's cumulative adaptation is no consequence stated here. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (World): 'Every selection through a selector's couplings selects histories alike exactly when they are alike through them. With the rest fixed, selection is blind beyond the coupling closure', with balance on what couples in (03's hypothesis). Not derived: 'whether an actual selection goes through the couplings, whether offspring follow the selection'. 'Known as the proxy problem' only 'in its blindness to what a proxy does not register, not its regressional or causal kinds'.

Theorem (World): past the slack of the dependences beyond one breaks, 'unseen by a selection rewarding the rise'. Witness Lapsing: 'selection alone does not carry the share'. That more offspring go to raisers is a premise.

'Counts of offspring see only what the selection couples into'; over cohorts of descent, where more offspring go only to formations that raise a family, the share reaching beyond is never selected against. 'The laws of §3–§6 restate known results'; the chapter adds 'no new population-genetic prediction'.

account_adds.en: An exact statement on any type of reader, joined to where a rise draws from, and the same law read across training and prices, that one law across domains being conjectured (T3).

source_adds.en: Cumulative adaptation as the explanation of organisms' fit, the argument against group benefit as a default, and every comparative case. The account takes the blindness, not the explanatory programme.

name.en: Inferring adaptation: Tinbergen's questions and the spandrels critique

source.work: Tinbergen, On aims and methods of ethology (1963); Williams, Adaptation and Natural Selection (1966); Gould and Lewontin, The spandrels of San Marco and the Panglossian paradigm (1979)

sense.en: Questions about a trait separate mechanism, development, function and history. Gould and Lewontin attack reading present use as origin: traits may be byproducts or constraints. Replies defend adaptationist reasoning as method. A methodological dispute, argued by cases, not a theorem.

reading.en: 04 section 8 holds the caution in a reading it labels AI's, naming none of these authors: four linked questions (mechanism now, development, what it does to continuation and reproduction, how its distribution arose), and 'A present benefit does not establish origin'. That has the shape of Tinbergen's four and the critique's point. Argued, not a theorem: no law here tells these apart. [AI reading]

says.en: Reading [AI reading, D65]: for a disposition 'ask what mechanism produces it now, how it develops, what it does to continuation and reproduction, and how its distribution arose. A present benefit does not establish origin; selection, drift, constraint, byproduct and cultural transmission must be told apart where they are live alternatives.'

account_adds.en: The burden carried to candidates: 'The same mature structure does not by itself identify its formative history', so one reproducing adult behaviour while leaving its origin arbitrary does not meet the burden 04 names.

source_adds.en: The spandrels case studies, the programme's critique and its replies, the comparative method, and how function is tested. The account gives no method for telling these alternatives apart on data.

name.en: Stage structure: the next recruits are already counted

source.work: Leslie, On the use of matrices in certain population mathematics (1945); Dennis, Desharnais, Cushing and Costantino, Nonlinear demographic dynamics (1995); Cushing et al., Chaos in Ecology (2003)
source.locator: locator unverified; the LPA model of the flour beetle, as I recall it

sense.en: A population's next state is read from its stage or age classes, not from the history of a total. In flour beetles larvae, pupae and adults are coupled by cannibalism, and the model forecasts laboratory cultures and predicts transitions between dynamics. Age structure is the ordinary state for many assessed stocks.

reading.en: T2 says a renewable condition's state is its level, recent giving and one lag. It claimed 'as far as anything measured does' and failed on frozen UE31b: 'Beyond the three numbers, the pupae and the adults removed 0.83 of the residual variance'. It is narrowed to 'as far as the level's own history does'. By that frozen comparison the field's state carries what the three numbers do not, in this domain and on its own cultures. On the adults' course alone the three suffice, 'a tie by construction', 'not T2 passed'. [AI reading]

says.en: Standing: 'conjectured, on the four frozen fish-stock tests above; untested on a wild condition outside fisheries'. T2's state is level, recent giving and one lag 'as far as the level's own history does'. 'The failure stays on record as a loss of the broader claim, not a narrowing chosen in advance'; it 'defeats T2's class as worded in that domain, not the reading 08 §9 names, nor T2 in the fisheries, where MQ5 passed'. A stage before recruitment 'may now carry more without counting against T2'.

UE31b, by cell, on the Beetle Team cultures: 'out of sample the field's state had 0.06 of their squared error in the median cell, and less in all 10'. Limits: 'the rival's constants come from other analyses, the unit is four replicates under one law, and the model that wrote the design may have met these cultures' series in its training text'.

account_adds.en: A forbidden item at the level's own history (a fourth variable from it removing a tenth of the residual variance), and a recorded loss of the broader claim. On fish stocks, 'the lag may be the assessment's own'.

source_adds.en: Stage and age classes as the state, stage-specific rates, cannibalism as mechanism, transitions among dynamics in cultures. Whether recent giving and one lag are a shadow of stages T2 does not read, in fisheries too, the field would ask and the account leaves open.
